'''Outpost 8''' was a base belonging to [[Sharlee]] in the ring of [[Constancia/Legends|Constancia]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Gamine]] ended up here in their mission to Constancia. Later [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[Gyla Petro]] made their way here while looking for Luke.
